verdict.rationale: Modal documents a Sandbox Snapshots guide and a `SandboxSnapshot` object created via `._experimental_snapshot()` on a running Sandbox. That is a first-party mechanism for capturing sandbox state to restore later, but it is marked experimental. Nothing in the evidence shows a pause/resume of the same running sandbox, or that memory (process) state is preserved rather than just the filesystem. missing for 10: explicit pause/resume semantics, evidence that memory/process state survives, non-experimental status, detailed docs content beyond page titles, independent or hands-on corroboration.
